name: Berry Pink Power Smoothie Bowl
steps: Chuck the frozen strawberries, raspberries, cherries and banana into a blender with the almond milk, yoghurt, protein powder, lime juice and chia seeds.

Start blending on a low speed. Use a tamper to push the mixture down towards the blades – it’ll take a minute to get going. Don’t add more liquid unless you absolutely have to. If it really won’t budge, splash in 10ml more almond milk at a time.
Scoop your thick smoothie into a bowl, then top with whatever you fancy – sliced fruit, coconut flakes, granola, seeds or a drizzle of almond butter.
